4-Bedroom Garden Villa | Bay Villas, Dubai Islands
.
Experience a new standard of island living with this stunning 4-bedroom Garden Villa in Bay Villas, Dubai Islands. Offering the perfect blend of modern luxury and natural tranquility, this home is ideal for families seeking an exclusive waterfront lifestyle.

Property Details:

Bedrooms: 4 spacious ensuite bedrooms
Bright open-plan layout with floor-to-ceiling windows
Modern fitted kitchen with high-end finishes
BUA 5,541 Sqft
Plot Size 6864 Sqft 
Covered parking for multiple vehicles

Key Features:

Private landscaped garden and outdoor seating area
Contemporary architecture and high-quality interiors
Seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces
Steps away from the waterfront and green parks

Community Highlights:

Premium beachfront community by Nakheel
Lush parks, cycling and jogging tracks
Close to retail, dining, and leisure destinations
15 minutes to Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport

Enjoy the peace of island life just moments from the city — Bay Villas offers a rare combination of exclusivity, elegance, and convenience.
